GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped evenly. Not pushed early & raced behind leader on inside (2L from lead). Tracked leader on inside midrace & improved to =lead on rail on home turn. Pressured @ 250m & hit lead @ 200m. Weakened in last 200m. # Every Chance

Slow Out 1 Lengths , sat touch Worse than midfield Two Wide 4 Lengths 800m, joined Leaders Middle Of Track soon after Straightening Up and looked chance, Just peaked last 200m and faded out of placings # run peaked 200m

Slow away. Not pushed early & raced keenly 2nd last Two Wide (6L from lead). Stayed same until pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 400m. Chasing 3 Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 250m & worked home OK in last 200m. # Slow out/OK late.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping, shifted in and bumped rnr. Raced keenly in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: began ok . Settled Down Two Wide 9th 5.5 Lengths @ 550m. Hooked Out much wider all Clear top of Straight , Just Held Ground from there # No Run On
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider was permitted to ride 0.5kg over the allotted weight of 57.5kg. Shifted in on jumping and made contact with another runner. Approaching the 600m was bumped and taken wider by a runner which shifted out and began to over race.
